title: ATLAS OFFER
hook: you have bought|the last bag you will need|three times
style: documentary photography, available light, weathered real materials, rich colour, sharp focus, high detail

music.tags: low sustained strings, slow tension build, single low piano note, sparse percussion entering late, restrained, cinematic

beats.prompt: a canvas backpack shoulder strap torn through mid-fibre, the bag dropped on a wet station platform, contents spilled across the concrete, rain, night lights
beats.motion: the torn strap fibres pull apart and the bag drops onto the wet concrete
beats.caption: It always goes at the worst moment

beats.prompt: a person crouched on a wet platform at night holding a broken backpack together with both hands, a train blurring past behind them
beats.motion: the hands grip the broken bag tighter and the train blurs past behind
beats.caption: Never near a shop

line.text: It goes on a platform, in the rain, with a train to catch.

beats.prompt: a wall of identical cheap new backpacks on a bright retail shelf under hard fluorescent light, price tags hanging
beats.motion: the price tags swing and the fluorescent light flickers across the row
beats.caption: Built to last about two years

line.text: Most packs are built to last about two years. Long enough for the reviews.

beats.prompt: a heavily worn olive canvas backpack on one shoulder, sun-faded and scuffed, mountain light behind, carried by someone walking
beats.motion: the pack swings up onto the shoulder and settles as the person turns away
beats.caption: This one is nine

line.text: This one is nine years old.

beats.prompt: extreme close up of doubled stitching on a canvas strap join, thick waxed thread, worn fabric, shallow focus
beats.motion: the fabric flexes and the doubled thread pulls taut without moving
beats.caption: Doubled where every other pack tears first

line.text: Doubled stitching, exactly where every other pack tears first.

beats.prompt: hands at a workbench stitching a worn canvas backpack strap with a heavy needle, tools laid out, warm work light
beats.motion: the needle pushes through the canvas and the thread is drawn tight
beats.caption: If it ever tears, we fix it. Free. Forever.

line.text: And if it ever does tear, we fix it. Free. For as long as you own it.

beats.prompt: the worn olive canvas pack on one shoulder, a person walking away down a trail into low evening sun, long shadow
beats.motion: the person walks away down the trail and the shadow stretches behind them
beats.caption: ATLAS. Buy it once.

line.text: Your current bag already has a date on it. You just have not seen it yet. ATLAS. Buy it once.
